_about: The Pachislop port's map (docs/specs/S84-title-library.md §6.7.1): Pachislop ids to library refs, families, bilingual names, font pairs, 2D reflection maps to S86 environments, field exceptions to the camelCase to snake_case rule (`<our schema kind>.<Pachislop key>`), members dropped with reasons (Pachislop path patterns: `[]` any index, `*` one segment, `**` any depth; `kind:<our kind>.<key>` for every place of a kind), template texts and the tag vocabulary the port derives synonyms from. Pachislop is by SafEight, used with the author's permission. S87's Pachislop importer reads the same file.

dropped.reason: every factory look is built in; the library knows a built-in by where its file lives
Pachislop's library section; the families of S84 §6.6 replace it (`family`)
a look holds no element ids (rims, bands, effects, lights take fresh ones when applied, S84 §6.1)
the 3D shadow catcher: S86 has none (S86 R67 drops it)
Pachislop's project format version (11); the document has its own `version`
the print resolution is S87's `dpi` member, not in this build; every Pachislop template has 72 (screen)
a stale key some templates carry beside `rays`: Pachislop's sunburst reads only `rays`
a Layers-panel view state; S80 documents have no solo
a background layer becomes a Fill generator, which always spans the canvas
